text: Artificial intelligence is changing how we work in many ways. One major effect is automation, where machines handle repetitive tasks like data entry or scheduling. This frees up employees to focus on more creative and complex work. Productivity tools powered by AI, such as smart email filters and project managers that predict delays, also help teams get more done in less time. However, the real power lies in human-AI collaboration. People still make final decisions, while AI offers suggestions and insights. Some jobs will change or disappear, but new roles, like AI trainers or data analysts, are emerging. Workers who learn to use AI wisely will likely find more opportunities.
